trigger: PUB-P2E04 established 103 RETRY_LOCAL_BAL cases in the immutable 162-case P2E03 Reference matrix, with class counts rising from 3/54 at requested coarse dt=0.0016 day to 46/54 at 0.0004 day and 54/54 at 0.0001 day. The residual-units erratum and PUB-P2E05 establish that HeadCalc compartment residuals and their convergence criteria are rate quantities in cm/day, while vector_F contains a storage-rate term (theta-theta_previous)*dz/dt.
scientific_question: Is the counterintuitive increase in Reference local-balance retries at smaller dt consistent with timestep amplification of a local residual/state-resolution floor, or is it primarily an insufficient nonlinear iteration budget under the existing strict Reference criteria?

scope.domain: exact immutable P2E03 six-material x three-Se x three-forcing x three-requested-dt matrix

stage_A_exact_replay_and_scaling_diagnos.rule: Reproduce the exact P2E04 first-failure classification at max_iterations=16 and retain every case. For each RETRY_LOCAL_BAL first-failure state, publish diagnostics from the exact failed stage before any diagnostic rerun.
per_failure_observations: material, Se, forcing, requested coarse dt and actual failed-stage dt
number of local-balance flags and index of the maximum-absolute local residual
maximum absolute local residual rate in cm/day
actual_dt times maximum absolute local residual in cm
storage-rate contribution (theta_candidate-theta_base)*dz/dt at the maximum-residual node
non-storage rate contribution defined algebraically as residual minus storage-rate contribution
theta representational spacing transformed to a storage-rate scale: spacing(theta_candidate)*dz/dt
summary_observations: LOCAL_BAL counts by requested coarse dt and failed stage
min/max/mean maximum-residual rate by requested coarse dt
min/max/mean dt-integrated maximum residual by requested coarse dt
min/max/mean ratio of maximum residual rate to the theta-spacing storage-rate scale where finite and positive

stage_B_iteration_budget_test.rule: For every baseline first-failure classified RETRY_LOCAL_BAL, rerun only that exact failed-stage request from the identical base state with max_iterations=64 and all other numerical and physical settings unchanged.
observations: whether the original LOCAL_BAL failure is cleared
stage_B_iteration_budget_test.decision_rule: Report the exact number of baseline LOCAL_BAL cases cleared at 64 iterations. Do not infer an iteration-budget cause merely from additional work; resolution requires the local-balance failure itself to clear under otherwise identical settings.

hypotheses.H_rate_scaling: If a residual/state-resolution floor is amplified by the 1/dt storage-rate formulation, rate residuals should become less favorable as dt decreases while dt-integrated local residual magnitudes remain substantially more stable than the unscaled rate values across the matched domain.
hypotheses.H_iteration_budget: If the dominant failure is mainly an iteration-budget limitation, a material fraction of the exact LOCAL_BAL failures should clear when max_iterations alone is increased from 16 to 64.
hypotheses.H_finite_precision_context: The theta-spacing-derived storage-rate scale is recorded only as context. Similar scale is evidence consistent with finite representation effects but is not sufficient to label the mechanism floating-point roundoff.

interpretation_boundaries: No diagnostic outcome authorizes a production tolerance change inside PUB-P2E06.
No diagnostic outcome repairs, deletes or reclassifies immutable PUB-P2E03 results.
A dt-normalized pattern is not by itself proof of floating-point roundoff because constitutive and flux terms also contribute to the nonlinear residual.
PUB-P2E06 does not establish a RossFast admissibility threshold or RossFast scientific admissibility.
Any replacement Reference calibration matrix or numerical-policy change requires a later separately preregistered decision.
qualification: exact reproduction of P2E04 counts: ACCEPTED=47, RETRY_TOTAL_ONLY=12, RETRY_LOCAL_BAL=103 and no other retry class
full F-CI canonical qualification on the PR merge image
next_permitted_action: Implement the publication-only diagnostic harness exactly as preregistered. Do not alter production/reference source or any numerical tolerance.
